title: feat: add community provider profiles
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Lets allowlisted community providers set one public name and HTTPS service link for all their models
- Exposes the profile through the shared model registry as `brand` and optional `brand_url`
- Links the provider name from community model rows in the Enter catalog
- Adds the nullable D1 fields, generated migration, validation, and focused integration tests

Tests:
- `npm run typecheck` in `enter.pollinations.ai`
- `npm run typecheck` in `gen.pollinations.ai`
- `npx vitest run src/community-endpoints.test.ts`
- `npx vitest run test/pricing-data.test.ts`

gist.headline: Providers get a signpost
gist.blurb: Community providers can now put one public name and HTTPS home link beside every model they share. A small label for a model row; a much better trail back to its garden.
gist.summary: Allowlisted community providers can now configure a public `brand` name and optional HTTPS `brand_url`, which are published through the shared model registry and linked from their model rows in the Enter catalog.
gist.impact: Users browsing community models can see who provides them and follow a verified provider link, while providers get a consistent identity across all of their listed models.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy community model catalog as a garden noticeboard: several code-plants have tidy provider name tags, with a small HTTPS link signpost leading from each row toward a friendly provider garden. Polli should be actively hanging a polished nameplate and link plaque, showing that one provider identity now travels with every model. Include a small eager monitor robot reading the catalog for extra discovery energy.
